# tickadoo MCP

The tickadoo MCP server lets your Muse discover and book theatre, events and experiences in 1,100+ cities worldwide — with a dedicated connectors/muse/ folder: a paste-into-Muse prompt, SKILL.md and an install guide. No API key; discovery happens through the MCP server and checkout stays on tickadoo.com. Honest heads-up: it primarily serves the commercial tickadoo service — the Muse connector is one folder of the repo.
